📺 You whisper: we both walk out, we split whatever they give. They stare. The audience leans in.
📺 MAIN EVENT rules: the arena runs hotter tonight. You start this one already hurt — the galaxy loves an underdog. Especially a bleeding one.
📺 The billing said EXTREME RISK. The System doesn't pull its punches.

📺 The bell — a sound like a dropped pan in a cathedral.

You circle. They circle. The ref-drone ticks off the seconds, loud enough for the cheap seats, while the crowd picks sides and heckles both of you.
📺 You trade. Clean hits, both ways. The crowd respects the honesty. Your ribs file a complaint.

📺 They yield — or they don't. The ref-drone hovers, sensors hot.

The crowd wants blood. The System wants a story. You want to go home.
📺 You press. They go down. The drone calls it. Your hands won't stop shaking.
📺 The highlight package is already cut. Hardened Duel will replay this forever — the club will remember.
📺 Hardened Duel — The damage was too much.
📺 "Not to the death," they said. The ref-drone logs it as an accident. Your opponent doesn't stop shaking for a week.
📺 The Death Reel will be tasteful. It won't be.
📚 Duel: you know its beats now. The intro will tell you what you've learned.
